name: Immanence of Set — 2 Intermediate — Lord of Storms

system.description:
Long before his incarnation as a tempter, Set was the god of darkness and storm. This power lets the Setite summon a sandstorm or thunderstorm of ferocious intensity, blotting out the sky and driving any sane creature to cover, while allowing the Setite (and his immediate retinue) to move about untouched, as if beneath a calm, clear sky.

System: The player spends three Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait to summon a raging storm blanketing the area within a square mile of the Setite; additional Willpower Traits may extend the radius by 10 miles each. The storm lasts at least one scene, and can last much longer at the Storyteller's discretion.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
